title: Minimum Cost to Hire K Workers
description: Calculate minimum cost to hire k workers by sorting workers by wage-to-quality ratio and using a max-heap to maintain quality sum.
pseudocode:
1. Create workers list with [ratio, quality]
2. Sort workers by ratio
3. Initialize max-heap for quality and sumQuality = 0
4. For each worker in sorted list:
5. Add worker.quality to heap and sumQuality
6. If heap size > k, remove max quality and subtract from sumQuality
7. If heap size == k, calculate current cost = sumQuality * ratio, update minCost

steps.note: Processing worker with ratio 2.5 (quality 20). Heap: [20], sumQuality: 20
Processing worker with ratio 6.0 (quality 5). Heap: [20, 5], sumQuality: 25
Heap size is k=2. Cost = 25 * 6.0 = 150.0. MinCost = 150.0
Processing worker with ratio 7.0 (quality 10). Heap adds 10: [20, 5, 10]
Heap size > k. Remove max quality (20). Heap: [5, 10], sumQuality: 15
